/flight-booking.title: Shayan Alam - Product Designer
/flight-booking.description:
Hi, I'm Shayan Alam.
I turn complex problems into intuitive experiences, with expertise in SaaS and B2B/B2C platforms.
h3: Converting Ideas into Products People Actually Wanna Use
p: UI UX Case Study | B2C Flight Booking
Building Trust to Drive Flight Bookings
Hoi had a airport customer base, but the challenge was to bring users onto the platform earlier in their journey and enable them to discover and book flights.

Increase flight booking conversion by using persuasive value cues—such as earning points, exclusive benefits, or added rewards at key decision points, encouraging users to move seamlessly through the booking journey from flight selection to payment.
Expanding Hoi’s user base to Unlock Flight Booking

To encourage users to book flights on Hoi, we introduced a clear differentiator: Zero Convenience Fee. Users would see the same promise throughout the journey—with no surprise charges added at checkout—helping build transparency and trust at the most critical moment of booking.
Existing Hoi users who already rely on Hoi for airport services and are familiar with the brand.
Travellers who compare prices and are sensitive to additional fees, looking for a transparent and trustworthy booking experience.
Round-trip booking adds complexity by requiring users to select and compare both departure and return flights.
Price transparency is critical — unexpected convenience fees at checkout can create distrust and abandonment.
Users need clear fare information upfront, including baggage, cancellation and refund conditions.
Comparing multiple flights can become overwhelming when price, duration, stops and timings compete for attention.
Users often want confidence that they are getting the best available deal before committing to payment.
The checkout experience needs to reinforce Hoi’s Zero Convenience Fee promise so users know there are no surprise charges.
We conducted a thorough competitor audit to understand industry best practices, identify gaps, and uncover opportunities to create a more effortless flight booking experience for Hoi users.
Simplify Round-Trip Navigation - Make the round-trip booking experience intuitive and easy to navigate, reducing cognitive load when selecting departure and return flights.
Create Confidence at Flight Selection - Use relevant persuasion and decision making cues on flight cards to help users understand the value and confidently move to the next step.
Communicate Why Book with Us - Clearly highlight our key benefits, especially Zero Convenience Fee to build trust and give users a compelling reason to book with us.
1. Simplifying Booking:  Less Hassle, More Confidence

We clearly separated the One Way and Round Trip journeys to make flight selection easier. We also introduced a Loyalty section to build persuasion and encourage booking, along with a dedicated section highlighting why users should choose Hoi for their flight bookings. Merged Add Travellers and Class into a single section to reduce clicks and simplify the booking flow.
Capturing Passenger and Cabin Class in one go to avoid multiple clicks
We designed dedicated One Way and Round Trip flight cards while also accounting for layover scenarios, ensuring a consistent and clear experience across different flight journeys.
If user tried to edit by tapping on the header - take them to populated search page
Animation not in loop - play once and then allow user to swipe and select

We clearly separated Departure and Arrival using a toggle, avoiding a single page layout with both flight selections to prevent a cluttered experience. After exploring multiple card iterations, we arrived at a cleaner design where users can quickly identify Cheapest and Recommended flights through clear tags. We also introduced combo offers, combining the best options based on price and recommendation.
Total Price of both the flights
Select your Fare and View Selected Flights

After selecting a fare for a flight, the user returns to the main flight listing screen. Both the onward and return flights are now selected, and the screen displays the individual fare for each flight along with the combined total price.

After selecting flights, users can review their chosen flights before entering traveller details based on Adults, Children, and Infants. We also clearly communicate the loyalty points they’ll earn with the booking, giving users an added incentive to complete the journey and move to the next step.

Users can easily select their Meal, Seat, and Luggage preferences, with separate tabs for the Onward and Return journeys. Selected add-ons and their corresponding costs are clearly summarised at the bottom, giving users better visibility before proceeding.

On the confirmation page, we clearly highlight the PNR, flight details, and total loyalty points earned from the booking. We also introduced a cross-sell section featuring relevant travel services to encourage further engagement and drive additional conversions.

Monitor the booking funnel to identify drop-off points and understand where users face friction. Use these insights to prioritise improvements, test solutions, and continuously optimise the flight booking experience.
Hand On Figma MCP Claude Code

I wanted to explore AI-assisted development hands-on, so I connected Claude Code to my Figma designs and started vibe coding the experience. Using the designs as a starting point, I experimented with translating layouts, components, and interactions into working code iterating between Figma and the browser to refine the experience.
Figma → Claude Code → Vibe Coding → Working Prototype
Currently based in Delhi. Always happy to connect

/mng.title: Shayan Alam - Product Designer
/mng.description:
Hi, I'm Shayan Alam.
I turn complex problems into intuitive experiences, with expertise in SaaS and B2B/B2C platforms.
h3: Converting Ideas into Products People Actually Wanna Use
p: Meet & Greet service is a premium airport assistance service offered by Hoi app, designed to make the airport journey faster, smoother, and stress-free. In other words Meet & Greet is a concierge service where an airport executive assists passengers through airport procedures from entry to boarding or arrival to exit.

The current Meet & Greet Hoi flow forces users to make multiple manual selections, including terminal, flight, and date, which adds unnecessary steps, increases effort, and raises drop-off rates. It also creates friction when users try to edit the number of passengers from the cart, making the booking experience less seamless and efficient.
What’s wrong with the current flow

Users are required to select the airport terminal and location before entering their flight number. This manual process increases the likelihood of errors, as the selected terminal may not match the entered flight, resulting in booking friction and validation failures.
At first we took his City & Airport Terminal then then he user entered his flight no. and date in this page and clicked on continue
This Page appeared if the flight no. didn’t match with the entered terminal. In this case there were drop offs as this involved multiple clicks on going back and entering the correct terminal
Our GA Events were showing user drop offs after user entered his flight no. This was a major pain point we needed to solve.
Analysing user behaviour on Microsoft Clarity

We analyzed user behavior using Microsoft Clarity session recordings and heatmaps to understand how users interacted with the page, enabling data-driven design decisions instead of relying on assumptions.
Who is this Feature Really built for?

We showed all the navigations here to illustrate each step a user takes within the app from initial setup to finalising their booking process. This helps visualise the user journey and ensures the process is seamless and user friendly.
Most users first tries to compare the plans before opting for any specific one.

B. The current flow creates a dead end after plan comparison. Users cannot select a plan directly from the comparison page and proceed with the booking, forcing them to navigate back and re-enter their details. This introduces unnecessary friction and interrupts the booking journey.
C. Instead of asking users the terminal first, we introduced the solution to ask the terminal later in the followed by 3 use cases which will be shown below.
D. Users initially click on cards mostly and not on the Book Now CTA, hence we decided to keep the section above CTA clickable.
Google Analytics showed high drop-off after users searched by flight number + date, especially when terminal mismatches dumped them into error states.
Removed flight number from the booking journey entirely and moved flight details to post-booking confirmation.
• Applied error prevention by cutting the dependency on flight search, so terminal mismatch failures can't happen in the booking path
• Applied progressive disclosure by collecting operational details only after booking intent is set, not before
Both flight-first and package-first journeys showed high abandonment, pointing to the flight lookup itself as the friction.
Let users commit to the service before entering operational details, removing the lookup as an upfront gate.
• Applied Hick's Law by cutting early decisions, so users reach commitment faster
• Reduced friction at the top of the funnel by not asking for operational input before the user has chosen to book
Users consistently explored "Compare All Plans" before deciding, but the comparison page dead-ended with no way to continue booking.
Added a "Book Now" CTA inside the Compare All Plans experience, turning the comparison page into a conversion point.
• Applied recognition over recall by letting users compare plans and continue without losing their place
• Converted an information-only page into a booking surface, meeting users where the decision is actually made
Users frequently returned from the cart to change guest count, causing backtracking and drop-off.
Removed guest selection from the flow and moved "Add Guest" into the cart, with pricing that recalculates from the passenger details entered.
• Applied journey continuity by placing edits where users naturally expect them, eliminating the round-trip
• Removed upfront complexity by calculating price dynamically from adult/child/infant details instead of asking for guest count early

Clarity session recordings revealed that users were open to exploring other services within the app, especially after completing a booking, indicating these were high-intent moments for service discovery.
Introduced contextual cross-selling across key touch points, in the Meet & Greet confirmation page, surfacing relevant services based on the user's
• Applied contextual relevance by recommending services when they were most useful, making discovery feel timely rather than promotional.
• Increased service discoverability and cross-feature adoption by turning high-intent moments into natural entry points for related airport experiences
The proposed UX improvements simplified the booking journey, reduced friction, and made service selection faster and more intuitive for users.
Currently based in Delhi. Always happy to connect

/cabs.title: Shayan Alam - Product Designer
/cabs.description:
Hi, I'm Shayan Alam.
I turn complex problems into intuitive experiences, with expertise in SaaS and B2B/B2C platforms.
h3: Converting Ideas into Products People Actually Wanna Use
p: Simplifying Airport Cab Booking on Hoi

Conceptual redesign of the Hoi Cab experience, driven by focused UX improvements. Our goal was to transform ideas into measurable hypotheses, validate them through user feedback, and scale the solutions that proved effective.

Increase cab booking conversion by making airport transfers easier to understand, strengthening value communication at the comparison stage, and supporting users through the entire journey—from selection to pickup.
The existing cab experience lacked clarity, making airport transfers difficult to understand and compare. This resulted in friction during booking and lower user confidence.
User Behaviour: Users struggled to distinguish airport transfers from city to city travel, causing confusion while entering pickup and drop locations.
Booking Funnel Analysis: The cab comparison page was the primary decision making point but lacked strong persuasion cues to encourage the next step.
User Feedback: The value proposition of booking cabs through Hoi wasn't immediately clear.
Post-booking Feedback: Users were unsure where to meet their assigned cab after booking.
Improve Journey Clarity: Added clear From Airport and To Airport labels with simplified terminal selection to reduce confusion.
Boost Purchase Intent: Introduced strike-through pricing, offer banners, and benefit highlights to increase perceived value.
Enhanced Decision Making: Redesigned cab cards to prioritize passenger capacity, luggage, fuel type, and loyalty rewards.
Built Post-Booking Confidence: Revamped the Why Book with Hoi section and added pickup guidance for a smoother arrival experience.
We redesign to validate hypothesis and user behaviour
We regularly check funnel and take data based decision for designs
Analysed competitor cab booking platforms to identify UX opportunities and best practices.
Below are the key use cases, challenges, and proposed solutions.
Users struggled to distinguish airport transfers from city to city travel, causing confusion while entering pickup and drop locations.
Added clear Source and Destination labels, making it immediately apparent that the service is for airport transfers.
Simplified terminal selection with better contextual guidance, reducing selection errors.
The cab comparison page was the main decision point but lacked persuasion cues to push users to the next step.
Turned the comparison page into a decision surface with strikethrough pricing, offer banners, an animated
"Why Book with Hoi" ribbon and visible loyalty points.
Applied persuasion design with pricing cues, offers and rewards reinforcing value right where the decision is made
Made rewards visible before purchase by surfacing loyalty points on every option, so the upside is part of the comparison, not a post-hoc surprise
The value of booking cabs through Hoi wasn't immediately clear to users.
Rebuilt the "Why Book with Hoi" section into visual cards with supporting imagery and benefit-led messaging.
• Communicated value through benefit-led framing rather than leaving users to infer why Hoi is the better choice
• Reinforced the proposition at the point of comparison, closing the gap between what Hoi offers and what users perceive
After booking, users were unsure where to meet their assigned cab.
Added a dedicated pickup guidance section on the booking confirmation page.
• Applied journey continuity by extending support past checkout to the moment it's actually needed — arrival
• Reduced post-booking uncertainty so confidence carries through to pickup, not just to payment
Designing Every Decision, Not Just Every Screen

The redesign was driven by a simple principle: every design decision should help users make the next decision with confidence. Instead of optimising individual screens, we focused on the complete booking journey.
Clear From Airport & To Airport labels
Simplified terminal selection to reduce confusion
Redesigned cab cards for easier comparison

Added strike-off pricing & offer banners to highlight savings. Introduced loyalty rewards to increase perceived value. Added a "Why Book with Hoi" ribbon to reinforce trust Surfaced contextual offers within the listing
Stronger value communication to build booking confidence
Reduce post-booking uncertaintyClear pickup spot guidance for a seamless airport pickup experience

The comparison page is where users decide whether to book or leave. By improving clarity, highlighting value, and reducing uncertainty at every stage, the redesign transforms a functional listing into a high-converting decision experience that supports users from search through pickup.

Hoi Cabs successfully crossed its first milestone of 100 bookings!This marks an important early achievement and validates the UX improvements and product decisions made while launching this new business vertical. It establishes a strong foundation for continued optimisation and future growth.
Currently based in Delhi. Always happy to connect

/corporate-project.description:
Hi, I'm Shayan Alam.
I turn complex problems into intuitive experiences, with expertise in SaaS and B2B/B2C platforms.
h3: Converting Ideas into Products People Actually Wanna Use
p: How We Simplified Employee Travel Management with AI for GMR Corporate users

Worked on simplifying the Travel Request (TR) journey and designing an AI-assisted Travel Expense (TE) filing experience through UX research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and cross-functional collaboration.

Hoi partnered with GMR to transform their employee travel operations from a paper-based workflow into a digital-first experience. We designed a Corporate Travel module that enabled employees to manage Travel Requests and Expense Claims seamlessly, while leveraging AI to automate expense filing and reduce manual effort.

This project highlights how we uncovered usability challenges in corporate travel management and redesigned the Travel Request (TR) journey while incorporating AI powered Travel Expense (TE) filing. The solution simplifies complex workflows, automates expense reporting, and improves the overall employee experience.

Corporate travelers currently face a complex, time-consuming Travel Request (TR) creation process, with multiple categories, fields, and decisions presented at once. This increases cognitive load, slows task completion, and raises the likelihood of errors or incomplete submissions. Returning users enter the same travel information, creating unnecessary effort and frustration.

Corporate employees currently spend 30+ minutes filing Travel Expenses (TE) because the process is manual, fragmented, and error-prone. Users repeatedly enter expense details, attach receipts, and verify policy compliance, which causes submission delays, inaccurate data, and frequent policy violations. This increases administrative effort for employees and approvers, reduces productivity, and creates frustration throughout the expense reporting journey.

Designing the mobile version of a Corporate Travel system (including TR – Travel Request and TE – Travel Expense) means prioritizing essential features, simplified UI, and fast access, since users are likely on the move. Here’s a focused approach i took while designing for the same:

The TR creation process is complex, requiring multiple clicks and lacking clear navigation. Similarly, the TE filing process is complicated, with manual expense entry making it time-consuming and inefficient.
The form-filling process is complex and time-consuming, making it difficult for users to complete and verify their profiles efficiently. This creates problem in Raising of TR and Settling TE.

Redesign the Corporate Travel experience by simplifying the Travel Request (TR) creation journey with a guided, intuitive flow while leveraging AI to automate Travel Expense (TE) filing. The solution aims to reduce manual effort, eliminate repetitive tasks, improve accuracy and policy compliance, and enable employees to complete travel requests and expense submissions faster with a seamless end-to-end experience.

Create a faster, smarter, and more intuitive corporate travel experience by simplifying Travel Request creation and automating Travel Expense filing with AI. The solution aims to reduce manual effort, shorten completion time, improve accuracy and policy compliance, and deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for employees and approvers.
We took into account enhancement opportunities, quick turn around and minimal effort to shape the direction for moving forward.

Our proposed solution simplifies the Travel Request (TR) creation experience by breaking the process into clear, category-wise steps, reducing cognitive load and making it easier for users to complete requests accurately.

On the Hoi Homepage User switches to corporate travel view where we have kept the functionality simple in the first fold itself.1.  User can raise their Travel Request2.  User can settle their Travel Expense against TR.3.  Travel Request and Travel Expense can be approved
4.  Tracking is easier for all TR & TE.
The Saved drafts can be viewed simply from here
Your upcoming Trips Card saved at one place

User now views a bottom sheet which says them to select their preferred Trip Category in order to proceed.They can select their trip for a Self/Employee or a Guest and the type of trip i.e Domestic/International.
On selecting Self/International category user gets redirected to the summary page of TR where they need to first fill up their basic details.

Categorizing the sections helps us organize the extensive form fields more effectively. Once users complete all the required sections, they can submit all the information in a single step. Also if they wish to quit in between they can save their information by clicking on Save as draft
These fields are non activated since Basic details are not filled
Trip Category can be updated by clicking on the edit icon

After the basic detail is added we have taken users Primary destination, now user can fill up his 1. Transportation details2. Hotel/Forex 3. Visa/Insurance 4. Passport Now after filling the Transportation Details the Submit TR CTA will be enabled and user can submit his TR or Save the filled information by clicking on Save as draft .
This Segment Opens up your Flight, Train or Bus Section where user submits his desired means of transport
This opens up your Hotel and Forex Option Where user enters the Hotel (City, Check In & Check Out Date)
TR is now submitted and DIN No. is generated based on that. User can now book his flight.The Status of TR No. will be shown in the Trips Section of Homepage

Our proposed solution uses AI to auto fill expense details from receipts and guides users through a simplified TE filing flow. Built-in policy validation reduces errors, cuts filing time, and improves accuracy.

In the old flow, corporate employees spent 30+ minutes filing Travel Expenses (TE) due to a manual, fragmented, and error-prone process. Entering every expense detail was time-consuming and frustrating.
The user had to fill each lengthy form i.e Ticket Expense, Accommodation, Per Diem, Conveyance, Miscellaneous, Forex Advance and come back to the summary page

To address our users' biggest pain point, we introduced Joey—Hoi AI's intelligent expense filing assistant. Joey automatically extracts data from receipts, invoices, and PDFs to pre-fill Travel Expense (TE) forms in real time, eliminating manual data entry. Powered by AI and informed by competitor research, it reduces filing time from 30+ minutes to under 10 minutes while improving accuracy and minimizing policy violations.
To simplify the experience, we broke the AI Expense Filing flow into five easy-to-follow sections, making the process more structured, intuitive, and user-friendly.

In the new flow, we are demonstrating the Travel Expense Filing through our AI Agent Joey. This will save our time as Joey intelligently extracts expense data and auto-fills the filing form section by section
User clicks on the Add Expense CTA and it opens the summary page of Travel Expense
This Travel Expense Summary Page asks you to fill up your Visit Details
Corporate User Fills up his visit details and clicks on Start Filing Expense
This initiates the automatic filing flow where Joey files your expenses by parsing the information from receipts.
All the files are uploaded and now user can click on continue filing CTA
Since user has uploaded all the information your following details gets automatically filled up such as :
Expense Submitted with AI in 10 Mins
Reduced the overall number of support tickets by simplifying the travel request and expense filing experience.
Currently based in Delhi. Always happy to connect
